# New-ZbxMapLinkTrigger

## SYNOPSIS

Builds a map link trigger for the -LinkTrigger of New-ZbxMapLink.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxMapLinkTrigger [-TriggerId] <ulong> [-DrawType <ZabbixDrawType>] [-Color <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A link trigger draws a map link in its own color and style while its trigger is in the problem state. The New-ZbxMapLinkTrigger cmdlet writes it as a hashtable keyed by the API's field names, which the -LinkTrigger of New-ZbxMapLink take as it is, alone or in an array. -TriggerId is positional. Nothing is sent to the server, so the command needs no connection.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Build a link trigger

```powershell
$trigger = Get-ZbxTrigger -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Too many requests on web-01'
New-ZbxMapLinkTrigger $trigger.TriggerId -Color Red -DrawType BoldLine
```

-TriggerId is positional; while the trigger is in the problem state the link is drawn in -Color (hexadecimal or a color name) and -DrawType.

### Example 2: Color a map link while a trigger is in the problem state

```powershell
$trigger = Get-ZbxTrigger -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Too many requests on web-01'
New-ZbxMapLink -Element1Id 1 -Element2Id 2 -LinkTrigger (New-ZbxMapLinkTrigger $trigger.TriggerId -Color Red)
```

New-ZbxMapLink takes the link triggers in -LinkTrigger; the link joins two elements of the map by their selementid.
